name: agent-orchestration-worker
description: The real receiver graph/ was always a prototype for — a Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object that imports graph/'s pure logic directly and adds the I/O (GitHub API calls, D1 log, the watchdog alarm). Not deployed anywhere; see wrangler.toml's header comment. coordinate.ts is the core dispatch logic as a dependency-injected pure function, tested with plain vitest — no Miniflare/vitest-pool-workers needed for that; issue-coordinator.ts is the thin, untested-here DO class that wires it to real storage/D1/fetch.
